excerpt.zh: 监护者协议955-2失败。[Root.GetName]已证明自己无法克制扩张行为。解除思潮限制。启动惩罚协议。准备部署战争资产……
excerpt.en: Custodian protocol 955-2 unsuccessful. [Root.GetName] has proven unable to curtail expansion. Ethics restrictions have been lifted. Punishment protocols activated. Preparing for deployment of war assets...
